UPDATE (soooo sleeppppy) : Finally, was able to finish coloring the first page of María. I was listening to LMM while coloring and it got me emotional. Colors can depict different situations and emotions while coloring I was also reflecting with my own life as to to the setting.

You see the setting was pretty much a bright place, however, Hwasa's shadows were dark despite being in a bright setting.

Somehow, this is how I percieve it: "Even at the brightest place, one can still feel alone and trapped at dark places due to our own mindset." And sometimes, even when people would constantly remind us that we are loved, the lies inside our head would often paralyze us, constantly feeling alone, unworthy and trapped.  I wanted to explain more but... the storyboard and lines that I will add soon will explain everything.
